# Container images VettID's CI pulls, copied to ghcr.io/vettid/mirror/<name>
# by .github/workflows/image-mirror.yml (docs/RUNBOOK.md "CI image mirror").
#
# One image per line: the upstream reference pinned by digest, then
# optionally other upstream repositories that serve the same digest (tried
# in order when the first refuses, e.g. a registry's anonymous data limit).
# <name> is the last path component of the repository; the mirror tag is
# <tag>-<first 12 hex digits of the digest>. Consumers pull by digest only:
#   ghcr.io/vettid/mirror/<name>@sha256:<digest>
# and keep this upstream reference in a comment next to it.
#
# Adding or changing a digest here and merging (or running the workflow)
# copies it; old digests stay in the mirror for older commits.
